coretrace.report.notes:
Counts represent event records, not item quantities or net damage.
Repeated actions are preserved. Rolled-back actions are not subtracted.
The parser supports the English CoreProtect CE format and some ES/PT verbs. Original text takes precedence.
CSV columns stay in English and server records are never translated, regardless of the menu language.
Missing fields stay empty; parse_status marks partial or ambiguous parsing.
CoreProtect does not provide a transactional snapshot through chat.
